subject.title: [Feature]: Option to skip tool list text in system prompt (reduce duplication)

question: Should OpenClaw add a scoped agent/default config option to suppress direct Tooling prompt text, or should this be handled only through existing Tool Search, code mode, and localModelLean surfaces?
rationale: The source gap is real, but AGENTS.md sets a high bar for new config surface and current main already has partial token-reduction paths that may be the intended product direction.

options.title: Add Scoped Opt-In
options.body: Introduce an agent/default option that omits only the human-readable Tooling list while preserving callable tool schemas and context reporting.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Tool Overhead
options.body: Make the broader open tool-schema/token-overhead work the canonical path and close this only after it explicitly covers direct Tooling text.

options.title: Rely On Existing Surfaces
options.body: Decline a new config key and document Tool Search, code mode, and localModelLean as the supported token-reduction paths.

recommendation.title: Add Scoped Opt-In
recommendation.body: Introduce an agent/default option that omits only the human-readable Tooling list while preserving callable tool schemas and context reporting.

likelyOwner.reason: Visible prompt/runtime history and the prior maintainer-side issue review point to steipete as the best available owner for the prompt/config contract choice.
